pages.text: [#](53341a)The witch's answer to drowning. Rather than parting the sea, it grows a hollow winter shell around the working, pushing liquid away and leaving a breathing chamber inside.[#]()
pages.title: Rite of Icy Expansion

pages.text:
[#](53341a)Worked from a small circle through a **Frozen Heart** trigger, and it needs a coven of at least two before the shell forms; stronger covens grow it larger.[#]()

[#](53341a)It grows in pulses, clearing the inside.[#]()
pages.title: The Working

pages.text: [#](53341a)Cast it under the ocean or in flooded caverns for a pocket of winter-made air.[#]()
